# Spellguard CLI Reference: Activity

Generated from: `spellguard schema`
Schema version: `4`

## Shared Envelope

- Success: data the command result payload (object or array); page pagination object (see envelope.page) on list commands, or null when not applicable; request_id server request id, or a locally-generated uuid for offline commands; warnings array of non-fatal warning strings
- Page: count number of items returned in `data` (its length) — the definitive quantity; never inferred from total; total size of the full result set when known; null ONLY when the true total is unknown (a walk that stopped at its safety ceiling); truncated true when more rows exist than were returned in this response — either a safety-ceiling walk stop (then total is null), OR a single limit/offset page that did not cover the known total (then total is the real number). In both cases: fetch more with --limit/--offset
- Error: code stable machine-readable failure reason; message human-readable description; remediation what to do next; request_id server request id when available; detail optional object; a deliberately curated, machine-readable safe subset of a typed server failure (e.g. code, installation_record_id, retryable, cleanup_state) — never raw upstream response bodies or secrets. Present only when the failure carries one

## Exit Codes

`0 ok`, `1 general`, `2 usage`, `3 authn`, `4 authz`, `5 not-found`, `6 conflict`, `7 network`, `8 timeout`, `9 confirmation-required`, `128+N signal passthrough`

## Global Flags

--base-url (string) - control-plane base URL (env: SPELLGUARD_BASE_URL); --color (string) - color: auto|always|never; --config-dir (string) - config directory (env: SPELLGUARD_CONFIG_DIR); --debug (bool) default: "false" - verbose diagnostics on stderr; --dry-run (bool) default: "false" - preview a mutating action without applying it (where supported); --format (string) - output format: table|json|yaml (env: SPELLGUARD_FORMAT); --non-interactive (bool) default: "false" - fail instead of prompting (env: SPELLGUARD_NO_INTERACTIVE); --org (string) - organization id for org-scoped commands (env: SPELLGUARD_ORG); --profile (string) - profile to use (env: SPELLGUARD_PROFILE); --quiet (bool) default: "false" - silence incidental progress on stderr; --yes -y (bool) default: "false" - pre-confirm destructive actions
